audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[N] reads Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly and every phases[N].why on rows 0-2, 5 and 6 describes Hwei winning that stage. Win rate 53.28% over 792 games supports it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 5 and 6 moved to Hwei as one atomic group; rows 3 and 4 already read Skill and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.mid claims you own the poke war from Lost Chapter with no mention that her level 6 spike takes her out of the lane entirely.
audit.why: Weaver's Wall is 180/150/120s with 2500/4500/6500 range — a map-rotation spike, not a lane-kill spike, which the content layer already says and the full layer does not.
audit.corrected: Mid and late re-keyed to the roam spike and to the ultimate splitting a teamfight.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text labels Unraveled Earth as (W) and calls the Worked Ground her W terrain. Nothing anywhere states the interaction that actually decides the lane.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth is E (14s flat, 950 range); Seismic Shove is W (14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, 900 range). Riot's E text is explicit: the mines stun only enemies who dash through them or are knocked through them. Hwei has no dash in any form, so Seismic Shove is the only way Taliyah can ever stun you — dodge the shove and her minefield is a slow.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected and the shove-into-mines dependency stated in spikes[0].text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, tradeBad and breakdown.carry.
sources: enemyKit W text and per-rank cd
ownerKit — no dash on any Hwei ability

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lintFindings), and dosFull[2].d asserts a "fifteen-second" window.
audit.why: Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1 falling to 8s at rank 5; Threaded Volley falls to 3s at rank 5, so her poke cooldown is never a window.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, and the fifteen-second claim replaced with the rank-1 14s.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Check it before every step-up. - E fear paint is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

notes: CHART: all seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[N] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei. Five rows moved to Hwei as one atomic group; rows 3 and 4 already agreed. No paired win[N] edits are proposed because win[N] already holds the correct token — a before==after edit is invalid. RATINGS left untouched (5/10-6/10 across rows that now split between Hwei and Skill; the semantics are not determinable from the data). DERIVED FLAG MISFIRE: the kit file marks Threaded Volley (Q) with grounding, but Riot's own description says only that it throws rocks and creates or consumes Worked Ground — no grounding effect. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about Q grounding. Seismic Shove carries the same grounding flag and its text is likewise only a knock-back; I left that alone too. UNVERIFIED: content.early asserts your poke out-ranges hers. Her Threaded Volley is 1000 range and the kit file lists every Hwei subspell range as 0 (they are form-swaps), so I could not confirm the comparison from the kits and left the sentence untouched.
